output_contract: Two cold-start files under their ceilings, with nothing lost.
The session's durable environment facts relocated to docs/reference/ where they survive the next handover rewrite.
SESSION_CLOSE with a fact-by-fact relocation table and before/after word counts.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Bounded editing of two documents against a FROZEN contract that already names the cuts. The judgment is in deciding which file owns a relocated fact, which is real but small; the reasoning-tier table puts routine documentation work at the lighter end and nothing here is a new decision.

requirements: English, per AGENTS.md engineering-output language law.

Before cutting, run 'python3 -m pytest tests/test_architecture_convergence.py -q' and note which phrases it pins in CURRENT_STATE.md. GOV.ORCH.6 section 3 lists the pins; verify each with grep before committing, because a pinned phrase removed is a broken build, not a shorter file.
Report the word count of both files before and after, measured as len(text.split()).
Commit early and often: the relocation commits first, the cuts after, so a reviewer can see nothing was lost.
Do not merge to main. The Product Owner assistant reviews the diff and merges.

Do not run the full pytest suite as part of your work. It creates untracked data/ and logs/ directories that the repository privacy gate then flags, which fails a movement whose diff is clean. The targeted suites in the validation plan are sufficient for a documentation movement.
risks: Deleting a fact instead of moving it, because shortening is easier than finding the owner. AC-5 exists to catch exactly this.
Raising a ceiling to make the test pass.
Making a statement vaguer rather than shorter, so the file passes the word count while saying less.
Running the full pytest suite and tripping the privacy gate on runtime residue.
Losing the environment facts, which are the most expensive thing in the handover to rediscover.

in: Reduce CURRENT_STATE.md to at most 1,050 words and AI_HANDOVER.md to at most 300 words, so tests/test_cold_start_budget.py::test_cold_start_word_count_ceilings passes.

Apply the cuts GOV.ORCH.6 section 2 already specifies, in particular its rows 8, 9 and 10: the predecessor list in CURRENT_STATE.md becomes one line pointing at project/build_history.json; the standalone Predecessor / OP.0b.0 / PAN HA blocks reduce to the live rows under Open blockers with one line each naming their design document; AI_HANDOVER.md's operating-role section becomes one pointer.

Move, never delete. Any durable fact that leaves a cold-start file must land where that fact belongs: build detail in project/build_history.json (through scripts/project_queue.py, never by hand), design detail in the design document that owns it, and history in docs/history/.

The environment facts currently in AI_HANDOVER.md section 5 are durable and must survive: the gradlew build exclusion, the absence of a .venv and the three requirements files, the measured per-turn worker cost and the DEFAULT_MAX_BUDGET_USD consequence, the full-suite-versus-privacy-gate validation-plan conflict, and the worktree-sensitive tool-gate test. Move them into docs/reference/ -- extend docs/reference/COPILOT_OPERATING_MODEL.md, or add one new reference document if that file is the wrong home -- and leave AI_HANDOVER.md pointing at it in one line.

AI_HANDOVER.md keeps only what AGENTS.md 'Handover economy' allows it: a snapshot of at most six lines, what changed this session as bullets, the exact next action, the test delta, and new risks. No decision re-litigation, no doc-editing mechanics, no restating a contract.
CURRENT_STATE.md keeps only the hot checkpoint and the sections AGENTS.md allows it, and must not contain a claim project/*.json does not support.
out: Changing AGENTS.md, AI_START_HERE.md or CLAUDE.md. All three are within their ceilings.
Raising any ceiling in tests/test_cold_start_budget.py. The ceilings are GOV.ORCH.6's own and are not the problem.
Deleting any fact outright, or dropping a fact because no obvious home was found. If a fact has no owner, raise a RELAY_QUESTION rather than deleting it.
Changing any project/*.json content other than by adding relocated build detail through scripts/project_queue.py.
Editing any FROZEN contract, including GOV.ORCH.6 itself.
Any change under ui2/, utils/, scripts/ or application/, and any code change at all beyond a test that must not be touched anyway.
Changing the meaning of any statement while shortening it. Shorter is the goal; vaguer is not.
